correctness.rationale: Rebuilt the exact DEAM Algorithm 1 scalar branch at theta=pi: beta=2*pi/[10(2+pi)], a=1-beta, x0=1, y0=-1, x_n=a*x_(n-1)-beta=2a^n-1, y_n=-(1/2)y_(n-1)-x_n as long as x_(n-1)>0. Since x1..x5>0 and x6<0, all five y1..y5 use precisely this branch; fresh independent recurrence gave y1=-0.2555938119, y4=-0.1143728760 and y5=+0.0148684705. Thus exactly four early increments are stale, versus exactly five for no-backtrack increments -x1..-x6. Enclosed beta between values from 3.14159<pi<3.14160; polynomially continuous formulas retain strict margins. No inference about adaptive beta after x6 or convergence on endogenous gradients. The source file verify.py is read, and the separate fresh_math_checks.py recomputation independently replayed the needed transition.
